clauses.title: 4.1 check --strict must report ALL PASS before work is declared done.
4.2 Reverse tests must prove it: a known-broken fixture goes red, then green again after restore. Without this, the gate is unproven.
4.3 Exit code 0 alone is never proof. Assert the actual property the task cares about.
4.4 No false green: a guard that fires on no input ever, or whose tests always pass by construction, is invalid and must be rewritten.
